title: Contents Packout & Storage Elevator and Stair Booking Charge for Unit Deliveries
content:
Contents Packout & Storage unit deliveries need elevator or stair booking for each load. On the move-back truck line of a return: **when the company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is for a multifamily unit property, each return load carries the multifamily access charge; when it is for a condo unit property, each return load carries the condo access charge; when it is for any other property type, or no company rebuild contract is read at that address, no access charge applies.**

The company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is the one at that address on the job's own claim file, or with no claim file when the job has none, and among those the one furthest along, taking a closed contract first, then a final invoiced, substantially complete, in construction, permitted, signed and proposed one in that order; a cancelled contract is never read; the company keeps one rebuild contract per claim file and address, added scope for the same claim and address being written as a change order on it, so no two contracts share that place in the order.

| Property type on the Reconstruction contract read | Access charge per return load |
|---|---|
| multifamily unit | 45.00 |
| condo unit | 30.00 |
| any other property type, or no contract read | none |
